quote: Recent research has explored the problem of aspect-based abstractive summarization.
Given a document and an aspect which can be a word or a phrase, the task aims to generate a summary that concisely describes information in the document that is relevant to the aspect.
This paper studies the new problem of summarizing a document on arbitrary relevant aspects.
